draft_en.subject: For the PoE switch category beside TRENDnet / TP-Link - two numbers, and who handles new vendors
draft_en.body:
Hello,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 6 October 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the PoE switch category beside TRENDnet and TP-Link in the store, at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity: 24 x Gigabit PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5 USD; 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed - STC-28DGGPM - $80.7. FCC/CE/RoHS (no UL listing - said up front, since some of your customers will ask).

One question: who handles new vendors for the store, so the datasheets go to the right person?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
